label: native-windows-direct-unicode-branch-probe
environment: A temporary HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, and empty Git global config were rooted below the owned probe directory; system Git config and prompts were disabled.

prior_diagnostic_attempt.reason: APPDATA was not redirected, and Git Town's attempted creation of C:\Users\abhir\AppData\Roaming\git-town was denied by the OS. No successful write was observed; the retry explicitly set APPDATA and LOCALAPPDATA inside the owned probe root.

interpretation: The pinned Git Town executable supports the Unicode branch name when launched directly with Unicode-preserving Windows process arguments. The hosted Playtestr mismatch remains attributable to an unisolated difference in runner launch, environment, or evidence path; this direct check is diagnostic only and grants no scenario or platform qualification credit.
